name: silk-math-preview
description: Live math preview that follows your caret. Inline LaTeX, Markdown, Jupyter, and MathJax equations with no compile step. 光标走到哪，公式就在哪渲染。

silkMath.enabled.description: 光标位于公式中时显示实时预览。Show a live preview while the caret is inside a formula.

silkMath.debounceMs.description: 合并连续输入的等待时间（毫秒）。Debounce delay for consecutive edits, in milliseconds.

enumDescriptions: 在当前公式下方悬浮显示。Float below the active formula.
在当前公式上方悬浮显示。Float above the active formula.
silkMath.previewPosition.description: 预览以不改变源码行高的浮层显示在公式下方或上方；旧 after/before 设置会自动迁移。Float below or above without changing source line height; legacy after/before values migrate automatically.

silkMath.enableInLatex.description: 在 LaTeX / TeX 文件中启用实时预览。Enable the live preview in LaTeX/TeX files.

silkMath.enableInMarkdown.description: 在 Markdown / MDX 文件中启用实时预览。Enable the live preview in Markdown/MDX files.

silkMath.enableInOtherFiles.description: 在其他所有文件类型中按 LaTeX 语法识别公式。Recognize math with LaTeX syntax in every other file type.

silkMath.previewScale.description: 预览相对编辑器字号的缩放。默认 1.35（界面显示为 100%）。Preview scale relative to the editor font; default 1.35 is shown as 100%.

silkMath.trace.description: 把每次渲染的表达式、尺寸与错误写入“Silk Math”输出面板，便于反馈问题。Log each render to the Silk Math output channel for troubleshooting.

silkMath.markUnknownCommands.description: 把未定义的命令按红色原文显示出来，而不是让整条公式渲染失败。Render undefined commands as red text instead of failing the whole formula.

silkMath.showRenderErrors.description: 公式始终无法渲染时在浮层里显示原因，而不是什么都不显示。Show the reason in the floating panel when a formula never renders, instead of showing nothing.

silkMath.previewDefinitions.description: 仅含 \def / \newcommand / \renewcommand 的公式默认不预览。打开后会把刚定义的命令展开画出来。Skip definition-only formulas by default; when enabled, render a sample of each newly defined command.

silkMath.showCaret.description: 在渲染公式中显示与源码同步的细光标。Show the source-synchronized caret in rendered math.

silkMath.maxFormulaChars.description: 单个公式允许预览的最大字符数。Maximum previewable characters per formula.

silkMath.rendererIdleMs.description: 无预览请求后释放渲染 Worker 的等待时间。Delay before releasing an idle render Worker.

silkMath.customMathEnvironments.description: 额外明确视为数学模式的环境名称。Additional environment names treated as math mode.

silkMath.quickFixOnType.description: 对高置信、无歧义的命令拼写错误显示诊断和显式 Quick Fix；不会静默修改源码。Offer explicit Quick Fixes for high-confidence command typos; source is never changed silently.

silkMath.ocr.enabled.description: 在状态栏菜单中显示按需安装的本地截图公式/文字识别入口。Show the on-demand local screenshot OCR entry in the Silk Math status menu.

silkMath.ocr.pasteImages.description: 在 LaTeX / Markdown 编辑器中将粘贴的图片识别为 LaTeX。Recognize pasted images as LaTeX in LaTeX and Markdown editors.

silkMath.tikz.enabled.description: 启用 TikZ / pgfplots 实时图片预览。默认关闭；首次使用下载本地 WebAssembly 渲染组件，之后离线运行，无需安装 LaTeX。Enable live TikZ / pgfplots image preview. Off by default; downloads the local WebAssembly renderer once, then works offline without a LaTeX installation.

silkMath.previewCss.markdownDescription: 预览 CSS：Silk Math → 编辑预览 CSS，保存生效；支持光标/选区/公式定位、上下/右侧、行间隔、字号、偏移、防覆盖与外观，清空恢复默认。Preview CSS: anchor to caret, selection or formula; choose above/below/right, line gaps, font size, offsets, overlap and appearance. Save to apply; clear to reset.

enumDescriptions: 自动与手动补全。Automatic and manual completion.
完全关闭此语言的 Silk 补全，不影响预览。Disable Silk completion in this language; preview is unaffected.

严格手动：Ctrl+Space 或 Silk Math: Trigger Math Completion；自定义快捷键需绑定 silkMath.triggerCompletion。Strict manual: use Ctrl+Space or Silk Math: Trigger Math Completion; bind custom shortcuts to silkMath.triggerCompletion.
silkMath.completion.mode.markdownDescription: 数学补全模式。可在 `[latex]`、`[tex]`、`[markdown]`、`[mdx]` 中分别配置。Math completion mode; supports per-language overrides independently of preview.

silkMath.completion.optionalArguments.description: 显示可选参数与必选参数不同的 snippet 变体。Show distinct optional-argument snippet variants.

silkMath.completion.packages.description: 为 Markdown 等没有导言区的文档补充宏包候选；只控制补全，不加载渲染宏包。Add package completions for documents without a preamble; this does not load rendering packages.

silkMath.completion.snippets.markdownDescription: 自定义命令名 → 完整 VS Code snippet（含反斜杠）；空字符串隐藏该命令。Custom command name → complete VS Code snippet including its backslash; an empty string hides the command. Overrides built-in and document snippets.

silkMath.preview.excludeFileTypes.markdownDescription: 排除指定文件类型的预览。填写扩展名（`.tex`、`.md`、`*.ipynb`）或 VS Code 语言 ID（`latex`、`markdown`），不区分大小写。空列表不按类型排除。Notebook 按所属文件判断。文件恢复按钮不会覆盖此规则。Exclude preview by extension (`.tex`, `.md`, `*.ipynb`) or VS Code language ID (`latex`, `markdown`), case-insensitively. Empty means no type exclusions. Notebook cells use their parent file. Restoring a file does not override these rules.

silkMath.completion.excludeFileTypes.markdownDescription: 排除指定文件类型的数学补全（包括手动补全）。填写扩展名（`.tex`、`.md`、`*.ipynb`）或 VS Code 语言 ID（`latex`、`markdown`），不区分大小写。空列表不按类型排除。Notebook 按所属文件判断。文件恢复按钮不会覆盖此规则。Exclude math completion, including manual completion by extension (`.tex`, `.md`, `*.ipynb`) or VS Code language ID (`latex`, `markdown`), case-insensitively. Empty means no type exclusions. Notebook cells use their parent file. Restoring a file does not override these rules.

silkMath.preview.excludeFiles.markdownDescription: 排除文件的预览。每项一条规则：`*.tex` 排除所有 TeX 文件；`notes.tex` 排除任意目录中同名文件；`chapters/draft.tex` 相对于工作区文件夹；绝对路径仅排除该路径；`**/*.tex` 匹配任意层级。支持 `*`、`?`、整段 `**`，不区分大小写，路径可用 `/` 或 `\`。留空不添加规则。Notebook 按所属文件判断；单文件恢复按钮不会覆盖规则。Exclude preview by filename or path. Use `*.tex` for every TeX file, `notes.tex` for that name anywhere, `chapters/draft.tex` relative to the workspace folder, or an absolute path for one specific file. Supports `*`, `?`, and whole-segment `**`, case-insensitively; either path separator is accepted. Empty adds no rules. Notebook cells use their parent file. Restoring a file does not override rules.

silkMath.completion.excludeFiles.markdownDescription: 排除文件的补全（含手动补全）。每项一条规则：`*.tex` 排除所有 TeX 文件；`notes.tex` 排除任意目录中同名文件；`chapters/draft.tex` 相对于工作区文件夹；绝对路径仅排除该路径；`**/*.tex` 匹配任意层级。支持 `*`、`?`、整段 `**`，不区分大小写，路径可用 `/` 或 `\`。留空不添加规则。Notebook 按所属文件判断；单文件恢复按钮不会覆盖规则。Exclude completion (including manual completion) by filename or path. Use `*.tex` for every TeX file, `notes.tex` for that name anywhere, `chapters/draft.tex` relative to the workspace folder, or an absolute path for one specific file. Supports `*`, `?`, and whole-segment `**`, case-insensitively; either path separator is accepted. Empty adds no rules. Notebook cells use their parent file. Restoring a file does not override rules.
